description: ADO-VIEW Filter literals on a client static read-only Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, L, D, C, Dt, S, Y FROM T ORDER BY ID: eighteen criteria (L = NULL, L <> NULL, L IS NULL, S = '', S = 'it''s', S = "alpha", Dt = #2024-01-02#, Dt = #1/2/2024#, Dt > #2024-03-01#, C = 2.25, D = 1.5, D = 1.50, L = '20', L = 20.0, Y = True, Y = 1, Y = -1, Code = 'a1' AND Dt = #2024-01-02#); for each assign Filter, read RecordCount and the matching IDs, then Filter none. Asks which literal forms the filter grammar accepts and how it compares Null, dates, booleans and quoting.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
